posts.title: Lasting impact extends beyond results
posts.description: The 2026 Rolex Sydney Hobart Yacht Race sets off from Sydney Harbor on December 26, with a fleet of 107 yachts taking on the 628 nautical mile course. Australian Tom Slingsby will be aboard the 100-footer Tribeca Loyal for the 81st edition. Slingsby, an Olympic gold medalist, three-time Rolex SailGP Championship winner, and three-time Rolex World Sailor of the Year, is quick to acknowledge that the race carries a weight all of its own. “I remember when I was younger; I had won Olympic gold and many world titles, but if I was ever in Australia, the one question I was asked was ‘how many Hobarts have you won?’ At that stage, I had not won any and, in fact, I had never done the Rolex Sydney Hobart Yacht Race. As a result, people did not think of me as a real sailor.” Slingsby has since competed on five occasions, taking line honors in 2016 and breaking the, then, course record.
